title: Exposure
description: A foggy night photo of light beams with a quiet white caption, and a camera exposure dial that clicks in thirds of a stop. Turn it up and the lights clip and halate red-orange, the caption blooms and the shadows lift into grain; turn it down and the night crushes to a few lamps.
intent: The blown-out, blooming lyric caption from herb's board turned into one physical control: a real tone curve over scene-referred light, so exposure compensation clips, blooms and halates the way film and phone footage do.
